cohort: 55 pregnant women or puerperia with heart disease and an equal number of women without heart disease at a tertiary care center in North Eastern India
finding: Congenital heart disease was the most common type of heart disease (49.09%), followed by rheumatic heart disease (41.82%), and cardiac complications occurred in 18% of women with heart disease, with congestive cardiac failure being the most common (80%).
mod_finding: Instrumental deliveries were higher among the cases (23.06% vs. 7.6%).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was higher among the cases (34.61% babies among cases and 12.73% babies among controls).
